_about: Official measuring stations near the lifts, surveyed 5 Nov 2026. Both are free, keyless and CC BY. Gust definitions differ: MeteoSwiss is the 1-second peak, SLF IMIS the 5-second peak, so SLF gusts read slightly lower for the same wind.

stations.name: Gornergrat
stations.note: SwissMetNet crest station, hourly since July 1993. About 8 km from the Testa Grigia / Klein Matterhorn link.

stations.name: Platthorn
stations.note: IMIS wind station above the Rothorn sector, 30-minute readings since October 1998. High and exposed, so the sensor can rime up in storms.
